method: Reviewer read each exact-name pair and judged it the same person from the full name alone. This is a name-based judgement: no dates, nationality or ULAN id were compared (the Art Institute publishes ulan_id for 1 of 17,017 agents), so it supports a review candidate, not a declared link.
